profile.headline: Modeling and Simulation Engineer Specializing in Computational Model Development
profile.summary:
Goals: 
1) Continually deepen my experience and understanding of physics and physical processes
2) Find innovative and efficient methods to model modern problems

positions.title: Private Tutor
positions.description: Provide private, personal, in home tutoring for post elementary students studying math, science, and engineering.
positions.insights: Skills: Problem Solving · Analytical Skills · Mathematics · Communication · Physics

positions.title: Thermal Engineer
positions.description:
Adapt to the shifting needs of the customer by acquiring new skills
Perform extensive verification and validation of numeric models
Conduct optimization studies by coupling models with optimization software
Utilize DoD HPC systems for high fidelity, multiphase CFD simulations with convective and conductive heat transfer
Model laser radiation with both deterministic and Monte Carlo methods
Communicate project updates to customers through regular briefings
Employ a range of tools (matplotlib, ParaVeiw, Matlab, Excel) to visualize results as both still images and videos

positions.title: Graduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
Perform conjugate heat transfer simulations (radiation and conduction)
Use computer models to analyze multiphysics problems (radiation and combustion)
Study the effects of employing novel mesh refinement techniques
Derive benchmark solutions from theory and use them to evaluate model performance
Create and execute a long-term project plan
Couple separate models written in disparate languages (Fortran and Python)
